title: GEMglColor4fv

messages.description: list of red, green, blue and alpha values of the current color

arguments.description: red value of the current color
green value of the current color
blue value of the current color
alpha value of the current color

body: [GEMglColor4fv] calls glColor4fv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glColor in the OpenGL reference.
